slides.title: Pilot goal
bullets: Reduce average first response time while preserving accurate, helpful answers.
Track response time and customer satisfaction each week.
Use the first week as the baseline for comparison.
Make responsibilities clear for each member of the pilot team.
Hold a weekly review and document decisions.

If demand grows beyond the team’s planned capacity, the pilot lead should review the backlog, identify which requests need urgent attention, communicate delays clearly, and adjust coverage using the agreed escalation process.

slides.title: Four-week timeline
bullets: Week 1: establish baseline and prepare the team.
Weeks 2–3: run the pilot and monitor results.
Week 4: review findings and recommend next steps.

slides.title: Team responsibilities
bullets: Support agents respond and flag issues.

slides.title: Risks and review
bullets: Limited coverage could increase waiting times.
Review results before deciding whether to expand.
